text:
sam: idea 3A add a small 'heatline' in per-model rows that visualizes estimated hourly token burn + a tiny risk pill (green/amber/red). hover shows a 24h estimate and the main drivers (sample rate, avg tokens/session, pinned routes). useful for infra & product triage.

jo: sounds useful. will this be live-calculated or based on precomputed snapshots? if live it could spike our routing metrics read QPS.

sam: prefer precomputed. we can run a nightly job + a short-window incremental job for near-real-time and surface a 'last updated' timestamp on the hover.

lee: watch out 3A telemetry sampling and retention means older sessions distort the avg. recommend: use 7d sliding window, clamp tokens/session at 90th percentile, and weight by route traffic share.

nina: API shape proposal for saved-query snapshot: add `badge_context` with simple fields. eg:
```json
{
  "badge_context": "route:rt_12;model:m_v3;sample_rate:0.01;routing_ver:7;last_update:2025-09-12T07:00Z"
}
```
Keep it stringified to avoid messy schema migrations.

jo: if it's stringified, parsing has to be safe across languages. maybe use a compact JSON string instead of semi-colon format.

sam: agreed. small compact JSON string. we just need route, model, sample_rate, routing_ver, and last_update.

lee: telemetry event please: `console.heatline.view` with fields `est_tokens_hour`, `sample_rate`, `window_days`, `cache_age_s`. helps validate model.

nina: rollout plan: feature flag org-level. start with internal org + 5 external customers on dedicated. expose toggle in console per-user: 'show heatlines'. also include an accessibility label: 'Estimated token heatline for model X'.

jo: caching decisions: cache key should include `routing_ver` and `snapshot_hash`. invalidate on routing ver bump or explicit signal. also expose a Prometheus metric `heatline_cache_misses` and `heatline_cache_age_seconds`.

sam: UX nuance: in per-model global list the heatline might be noisy. show compact glyph there and full sparkline only in per-route drilldown.

lee: math note: compute est_tokens_hour = sample_rate * total_route_requests_per_hour * avg_tokens_per_request. use median trimmed avg to reduce tail noise. store intermediate `total_route_requests_per_hour` from routing telemetry (already exists).

nina: copy for hover: 'Estimated tokens/hour for this model based on current routing and sampling. Not a guarantee; helps identify quota hotspots.' add link 'How this is computed' to docs.

ci-bot: cicd: canary deploy queued for service "console-heatline" namespace=console-canary ref=abc123.

jo: i'll draft an internal API PR with example responses and a small schema. pinging @sam @lee for review.

sam: thanks. i'll add a small note in the product spec about confusion cases (multi-model routes, model fallback routing).

lee: also record a one-off eval run comparing estimated vs actual token burn for 30 days after rollout to tune thresholds for amber/red.

nina: will add rollout checklist and brief survey to capture whether teams found it actionable.

sam: cool, assigning PR to @jo. follow-ups: a) telemetry events b) docs link c) redis cache with routing_ver key.

ci-bot: canary deploy started for console-heatline (pod=heatline-v2-canary).
